jornada-ia.titulo: From chat to agent: the overview

seq3-filas.titulo: Ten tasks and go to sleep

inicio.titulo: From chat to agent: the four steps to put AI to work for you
inicio.lead: Terminal, your own assistant, task queue and social media on autopilot. In six short lessons you understand each step, see how the pieces connect, and leave with the plan and templates to do it in the right order.
inicio.capa_alt: From chat to agent: the journey in four sequences — terminal, Jarvis, queues and social media.

cursos.sub: Each step has a full course, with practice and a quiz. Take them in order or go straight to what you need now.

itens.l: Open the terminal without fear, install the agent, set up the folder with rules, save every version with Git and put your page online.
An assistant with the memory and personality you define: four text files, a core built with tests, and chat over Telegram.

itens.t: Queues: ten tasks and go to sleep
itens.l: Send ten tasks, go to sleep and check in the morning: what goes into the queue, the inemaccbot and the gates before what matters.
Reel in 7 stages, videos by audience and the channel for your niche that checks every number and only posts what you approved.

inicio.aulas_sub: An overview of each step. Each step has a complete course, linked at the end of its lesson.

itens: People who use ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini and want to stop copying and pasting.
Professionals who want an assistant of their own and tasks running without constant supervision.
People who will guide teams or clients through this transition and need the full map.

blocos.t: What you'll be able to do
itens: Say which step you're on and what the next step is.
Set up the agent's folder with AGENTS.md, Git and secrets kept out of the text.
Design your own assistant, your own queue with gates, and the channel for your niche with the source on screen.
Follow a four-week plan with 23 verifiable exercises.
